title: Doppler secret custody
principles: Trace each value to a real consumer before Doppler admission.
Use fixed root wrappers and credential-neutral internal commands.
Give each hosted config one read-only, config-scoped, expiring token.
Keep local, CI, Preview, Production, provider and public claims separate.
Retain legacy credentials until the merged path has independent proof and cleanup approval.

tasks.title: Prove the consumer inventory and Doppler layout
tasks.description: Trace current source, workflow, Vercel, Alchemy, GitHub and secret-custody metadata, then admit only dev, stg and prd.
implementationNotes: Verified the exact repository, Personal Doppler workplace, GitHub Environments, Personal Vercel team/projects, current missing Git links, R2 state owner and current workflow consumers without reading secret values.
Confirmed Personal Developer plan does not expose service accounts or OIDC identities, so the fallback is expiring config-scoped service tokens.
mandatoryVerification: Every inventory row names source owner, consumer, environment, classification, desired config and migration state.
No Vercel runtime value or Alchemy deployment ownership is moved into Doppler.
The synthetic Executor endpoint and key are classified as non-secret local verification inputs.
completionCriteria: Only real consumers support dev, stg and prd.
Naming and least-privilege decisions are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement bounded repository and provider custody
tasks.description: Add root/internal command splits, pinned output-only workflow fetches, executable contract tests, Doppler metadata, and exact GitHub Environment tokens without deleting legacy values.
mandatoryVerification: Workflow tests reject a changed action pin, direct legacy secret reference, missing named output, broad injection, root wrapper use in GitHub and fork credential exposure.
Knip accepts the external Doppler binary and no other lint or boundary rule is weakened.
Doppler readback reports only project/config/key names and token scope/expiry metadata; GitHub readback reports only secret names.
Existing Effect Schemas, redacted Config values, exact project routing, provider Layers, replay and receipt contracts remain unchanged.
completionCriteria: Repository checks pass on the exact source.
Doppler and GitHub metadata match the approved three-config layout.
No legacy provider secret or variable is deleted or revoked.

tasks.title: Open the PR and separate hosted proof from non-claims
tasks.description: Push the focused branch, open a PR to main, wait for checks, fix change-caused failures and record exact remaining cleanup.
mandatoryVerification: Hosted CI is bound to the exact PR head SHA.
Same-repository Preview drift proves only the stg fetch and report path when it runs successfully.
No Production workflow, deployment, promotion, public journey, secret deletion or token revocation is triggered.
A fresh ownership/call-graph, implementation-quality and verification-coverage review finds no unresolved change-caused defect.
completionCriteria: The PR URL and final check state are recorded.
Remaining post-merge proof and cleanup need explicit approval and exact target readback.
